gloss: unhulled rice; rice in the husk

definitions.gloss: unhulled rice; rice in the husk; paddy
definitions.explanation: Rice grains that still have their outer husk on, as harvested from the plant before threshing and hulling.

examples.japanese: {籾|もみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{籾|もみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: We store the harvested unhulled rice in the warehouse.

examples.japanese: {籾|もみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you remove the husk from unhulled rice, you get brown rice.

notes:
Rice as it comes off the plant, still wrapped in its hard outer husk. After drying, the husk is removed to make ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧ (brown rice), which is then polished into ⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧ (white rice).

- ⟦{籾殻|もみがら}→籾殻：28136_momigara⟧: rice husk — the outer covering removed from the grain
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧: brown rice — hulled but unpolished
- ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧: rice plant — the growing plant that produces {籾|もみ}
